verdict.rationale: Gram offers broad programmatic control of the platform. The platform MCP server lets an org admin add servers, configure plugins and recipients, author skills, manage roles, review shadow servers, set risk policies, configure telemetry and read observability data "without opening the dashboard." The gram CLI handles auth, staging, deployments and toolset installs. However, the probes found no published OpenAPI spec or REST API, and nothing claims full UI parity. missing for 10: a documented public REST API/OpenAPI spec, an explicit UI-to-API parity guarantee, programmatic coverage of dashboard-only features such as the in-dashboard agent playground and deployment retry/redeploy, and independent corroboration.
